requests.reply: {"t": [{"id":0, "text": "New Hire Onboarding Guide"}, {"id":1, "text": "Welcome to MoaLogis."}, {"id":2, "text": "This document guides you through what to do in order for the first 2 weeks ▶"}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "For inquiries, please contact HR Manager Joonho Byun."}, {"id":1, "text": "Seojin Um will help you set up the development environment."}, {"id":2, "text": "Day 1"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "When you arrive, first get your access badge at the reception desk on the first floor."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The access card you receive will be registered by Manager Byun Jun-ho."}, {"id": 1, "text": "The seats are next to the Dawn Team, and Eom Seo-jin will sit in the same row."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Lunch is eaten with the team members"}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "The second day"}, {"id":1, "text": "On the second day, we spend the whole day on-site."}, {"id":2, "text": "We observe the unloading process while wearing safety shoes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "We do not approach the drivers who are working."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The experience report is submitted to the team leader for approval."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once confirmed, it will be passed on to Manager Byun Jun-ho."}, {"id": 2, "text": "First week"}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "New hires at MoaLogis go through a task list called 'Launchpad' in their first week."}, {"id":1, "text": "Launchpad item 1 is logging into the wiki and joining the company messenger."}, {"id":2, "text": "Company-wide announcements and casual chat take place in the 'Hearth' channel."}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "Step 2 is taking the Pathfinder training for the fleet allocation system."}, {"id":1, "text": "You will create a day's worth of fleet allocation plan yourself using the Pathfinder."}, {"id":2, "text": "Do not post the practice screen on Hearth."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You don't have to write a long report."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once you finish all the stepping stones, you'll start the practical work from the second week."}, {"id": 2, "text": "The first practical task is to receive a code review with Eom Seo-jin."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Code review results will be shared in the Modakbul team channel."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "If you have any questions, feel free to ask Manager Byun Jun-ho." }, {"id": 1, "text": "Finally, just leave a line about your impressions on Modakbul."}]}

translations.10: Lunch is eaten with the team members
translations.12: On the second day, we spend the whole day on-site.
translations.13: We observe the unloading process while wearing safety shoes.
translations.14: We do not approach the drivers who are working.
translations.15: The experience report is submitted to the team leader for approval.
translations.16: Once confirmed, it will be passed on to Manager Byun Jun-ho.
translations.18: New hires at MoaLogis go through a task list called 'Launchpad' in their first week.
translations.19: Launchpad item 1 is logging into the wiki and joining the company messenger.
translations.20: Company-wide announcements and casual chat take place in the 'Hearth' channel.
translations.21: Leave a short self-introduction in Hearth.
translations.22: Step 2 is taking the Pathfinder training for the fleet allocation system.
translations.23: You will create a day's worth of fleet allocation plan yourself using the Pathfinder.
translations.24: Do not post the practice screen on Hearth.
translations.25: You don't have to write a long report.
translations.26: Once you finish all the stepping stones, you'll start the practical work from the second week.
translations.27: The first practical task is to receive a code review with Eom Seo-jin.
translations.28: Code review results will be shared in the Modakbul team channel.
translations.29: If you have any questions, feel free to ask Manager Byun Jun-ho.
translations.3: This document guides you through what to do in order for the first 2 weeks ▶
translations.30: Finally, just leave a line about your impressions on Modakbul.
